desc: SolarWinds Dameware was found to be affected by a DLL hijacking vulnerability. The hijack occurs during installations only and requires access to the local machine and admin privileges.
title: SolarWinds Dameware DLL Hijacking Vulnerability

desc: SolarWinds Dameware was found to be affected by a buffer overflow vulnerability that can result in remote code execution. Authentication is required.
title: SolarWinds Dameware Buffer Overflow Vulnerability

desc: SolarWinds Dameware was found to be affected by a command injection vulnerability that could lead to the compromise of the remotely controlled host. Authentication is required.
title: SolarWinds Dameware Command Injection Vulnerability

desc: An issue in im3x Scriptables through v2-dev branch allows attackers to inject arbitrary OS commands via uploading a file with a crafted filename to the /sync endpoint.

TeXlyre from 0.11.0 before 0.13.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows attackers to execute script by supplying malicious LSP or typesetter recipe icons. Attackers can trick victims into importing a recipe whose icon contains an HTML event handler, persistently accessing local projects and repository credentials.
title: TeXlyre from 0.11.0 before 0.13.5 Stored XSS via Recipe Icon Import

desc: Solanum before commit 2ce64de contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows a malicious linked server to corrupt memory by sending overlong channel names in JOIN or SJOIN messages. Attackers controlling a peer server can trigger strcpy and sprintf overflows in ms_join and ms_sjoin to crash the ircd or potentially achieve remote code execution.
title: Solanum before commit 2ce64de Heap Buffer Overflow via JOIN and SJOIN

desc: Solanum before commit 2ea1382 contains a buffer overflow vulnerability in ms_kill() that allows malicious linked servers to corrupt memory by sending an overlong kill reason. Attackers controlling a rogue or compromised peer server can send a reason exceeding KILLLEN that overflows a static 512-byte buffer, crashing the ircd or potentially achieving remote code execution.
title: Solanum before commit 2ea1382 Buffer Overflow via Server-to-Server KILL Handler

desc: Lightdash 0.2609.0 before 3.137.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the RenameService that allows authenticated users with update Project permission on one project to access and modify dashboards belonging to a different project, caused by the failure to verify that the projectUuid from the URL matches the projectUuid of the target dashboard. Attackers can send crafted POST requests to the rename/dashboard endpoint to modify foreign dashboard filters and break charts, or send GET requests to the rename/dashboard/fields endpoint to read field metadata from projects they do not have access to.
title: Lightdash 0.2609.0 before 3.137.0 Cross-Project IDOR via RenameService Dashboard Endpoints

desc: Coolify before 4.1.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to enumerate application names across all teams via manual GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Gitea webhooks. Attackers can send a repository name of % or empty with a common branch like main, exploiting unescaped LIKE wildcards to receive every matching application name before signature verification.
title: Coolify before 4.1.1 Application Name Enumeration via Manual Webhook Endpoints

desc: wlroots before 0.20.2 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in read_surface_class() in xwayland/xwm.c that allows local X11 clients to leak compositor heap memory. Attackers can set a WM_CLASS property with a NUL-terminated instance but unterminated class, exposing over-read heap bytes as the window class or app_id over IPC.
title: wlroots before 0.20.2 Out-of-Bounds Read via read_surface_class() in xwm.c

desc: A vulnerability was found in phpMyAdmin SQL-Parser 6.0.0/6.0.1. The affected element is the function parse of the file src/Statements/ExplainStatement.php. Performing a manipulation of the argument nextToken results in incorrect type conversion. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
title: phpMyAdmin SQL-Parser ExplainStatement.php parse type conversion

desc: A vulnerability has been found in phpMyAdmin ShapeFile up to 4.0.1. Impacted is the function ShapeRecord::loadFromFile of the component SHP File Handler. Such manipulation leads to infinite loop. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
title: phpMyAdmin ShapeFile SHP File loadFromFile infinite loop

desc: MongoDB Database Tools mongorestore inconsistently handles the system.buckets. prefix when validating collection names in an untrusted dump. A specially crafted collection name can bypass special-collection guards and operator namespace filters, causing a restore to create an unauthorized user-chosen database account, including an account with the root role. Exploitation requires an operator to restore unauthorized user-controlled data using credentials with sufficient user-management privileges on the destination deployment. Excluding the admin namespace alone does not prevent this behavior. This issue affects MongoDB Database Tools versions 100.4.0 through versions before 100.20.1.
title: mongorestore may bypass collection guards through a system.buckets prefix

desc: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Barn2 Plugins Posts Table with Search & Sort posts-data-table allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Posts Table with Search & Sort: from n/a through 1.4.14.
products: barn2 plugins:posts table with search & sort
title: WordPress Posts Table with Search & Sort plugin <= 1.4.14 - Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability

desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Uncanny Owl Uncanny Automator uncanny-automator allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Uncanny Automator: from n/a through 7.7.1.
title: WordPress Uncanny Automator plugin <= 7.7.1 - Broken Access Control vulnerability

desc: A flaw was found in the GStreamer JPEG 2000 decimator in gst-plugins-bad. Crafted JPEG 2000 media can cause integer overflows or division by zero during tile processing. An application that processes the malicious media may crash, resulting in a denial of service.
title: Gst-plugins-bad: gst-plugins-bad: integer overflows and division by zero in jpeg 2000 decimator

desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in weDevs Dokan dokan-lite allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Dokan: from n/a through 5.3.2.
title: WordPress Dokan plugin <= 5.3.2 - Broken Access Control vulnerability

desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WebberZone Better Search better-search allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Better Search: from n/a through 4.5.2.
title: WordPress Better Search plugin <= 4.5.2 - Broken Access Control vulnerability

desc: MongoDB Database Tools mongofiles uses a database-stored GridFS filename as the output destination for get_id when --local is not specified. A user who can modify the file metadata can set the stored filename to '-', causing a later authorized retrieval to write the file contents to standard output instead of a local file. If standard output is captured in a location accessible to that user, this may disclose GridFS content the user cannot read directly. Exploitation requires a higher-privileged operator to retrieve the affected file without an explicit local destination and attacker access to the captured output. This issue affects MongoDB Database Tools from version 3.1.4 through versions before 100.20.1.
title: mongofiles may disclose GridFS content to standard output through a stored filename

desc: MongoDB Database Tools mongofiles does not resolve existing parent-directory symlinks when validating output paths for get_regex. An unauthorized user who can both upload a GridFS file and place a symlink in the operator's download working directory can cause a later retrieval to create a file containing unauthorized user-controlled data outside that directory, using the operator process's filesystem permissions. The issue can occur with default traversal and overwrite settings. Exploitation requires an operator to retrieve matching files from the affected working directory; the demonstrated default behavior creates a new file rather than overwriting an existing file. This issue affects MongoDB Database Tools versions 100.2.0 through versions before 100.20.1.
title: mongofiles may write outside the working directory through a symlink

desc: MongoDB Database Tools mongorestore incorrectly URL-decodes an original collection name read from metadata when the corresponding dump filename has been truncated. A database user who can create and populate a suitably encoded collection can cause a later authorized directory restore to write those documents into a different collection that the user cannot modify directly. When both collection names resolve to the same destination, backed-up documents may be omitted; use of --drop can also replace the unintended destination collection. Exploitation requires an operator to restore the affected collection from a directory dump with write access to the destination. This issue affects MongoDB Database Tools versions 100.0.2 through versions before 100.20.1.
title: mongorestore may restore encoded collection names into an unintended collection

desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in eranfl ClickCease Click Fraud Protection clickcease-click-fraud-protection allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects ClickCease Click Fraud Protection: from n/a through 3.3.0.
title: WordPress ClickCease Click Fraud Protection plugin <= 3.3.0 - Broken Access Control vulnerability

desc: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Cozmoslabs Paid Member Subscriptions paid-member-subscriptions allows Stored XSS.This issue affects Paid Member Subscriptions: from n/a through 3.1.3.
title: WordPress Paid Member Subscriptions plugin <= 3.1.3 - Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability

desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in weDevs Dokan dokan-lite allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Dokan: from n/a through 5.3.2.
title: WordPress Dokan plugin <= 5.3.2 - Broken Access Control vulnerability

desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WPMU DEV Forminator forminator allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects Forminator: from n/a through 1.58.3.
title: WordPress Forminator plugin <= 1.58.3 - Broken Access Control vulnerability

desc: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in WPMU DEV Forminator forminator allows Code Injection.This issue affects Forminator: from n/a through 1.58.3.
title: WordPress Forminator plugin <= 1.58.3 - Content Injection vulnerability

desc: Improper Certificate Validation (CWE-295) in the operating system certificate bundle shipped in the Docker images of APM Server; Auditbeat, Filebeat, Heartbeat, Metricbeat and Packetbeat; Elastic Agent, including Fleet Server and Cloudbeat; Logstash, for TLS connections that use the operating system certificate bundle; Elastic connectors; Universal Profiling (host agent, collector and symbolizer); and Elastic Maps Server. This certificate bundle, a dependency of these products (Dependency on Vulnerable Third-Party Component, CWE-1395), could allow an attacker to intercept or modify TLS-protected traffic via Signature Spoofing by Key Theft (CAPEC-474). The certificate bundle includes root certificate authorities that signed eight eMudhra intermediate certificate authorities whose private keys are compromised. Anyone with these keys can issue a certificate for any host name that these products accept as trusted. Exploitation requires an attacker in a network position between the product and the remote party, who presents a certificate issued with one of the compromised keys.
title: Improper Certificate Validation in Elastic Docker Images Leading to Interception of TLS Connections

desc: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling (CWE-770) in Elasticsearch can lead to denial of service via a specially crafted input value that is processed by an affected phonetic encoder of the analysis-phonetic plugin. An authenticated user with permission to write documents to or run searches against an index that uses an affected encoder can cause an Elasticsearch node to exhaust its heap memory. The node can become unresponsive or terminate.
title: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling in Elasticsearch Leading to Denial of Service

desc: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling (CWE-770) in APM Server can lead to denial of service via Oversized Serialized Data Payloads (CAPEC-231). An attacker who can send OpenTelemetry (OTLP) data to APM Server over HTTP can cause APM Server to exhaust its memory and terminate. This stops the intake of APM and OpenTelemetry data until APM Server restarts.
title: Allocation of Resources Without Limits or Throttling in APM Server Leading to Denial of Service

desc: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key (CWE-639) in Kibana Machine Learning can lead to information disclosure via Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs (CAPEC-1). An authenticated user with Machine Learning read access in one Kibana space can read the audit and error messages of data frame analytics jobs that belong to other spaces that the user is not authorized to access. These messages can include job details such as destination index names, analyzed field names, and failure information.
title: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key in Kibana Leading to Information Disclosure

desc: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data (CWE-201) in Kibana Observability onboarding can lead to disclosure of the credentials that Kibana uses to connect to Elasticsearch. When these credentials are embedded in the Elasticsearch host URLs in the Kibana configuration, an authenticated user with the privileges to onboard Observability data can obtain them. The user can then access Elasticsearch directly with the privileges of the Kibana service account, which are outside the privileges granted to that user.
title: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data in Kibana Leading to Credential Disclosure

desc: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory (CWE-22) in the Kibana Fleet feature can lead to unauthorized resource deletion via Path Traversal (CAPEC-126). A low-privileged user with Fleet agent policies write access could cause a subsequent administrative action to act on unintended resources. This can result in the deletion of resources such as Kibana spaces and other organizational assets that the low-privileged user cannot delete directly. Exploitation requires an administrator to interact with the affected Fleet interface.
title: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory in Kibana Leading to Unauthorized Resource Deletion

desc: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key (CWE-639) in Kibana can lead to information disclosure via Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs (CAPEC-1). An authenticated user with read access to connectors in one Kibana space can retrieve connector execution log information from other spaces that they are not authorized to access. The disclosed information includes connector names and identifiers, execution status, timestamps, error messages, and aggregated execution statistics.
title: Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key in Kibana Leading to Information Disclosure

desc: NULL Pointer Dereference (CWE-476) in the AMQP protocol parser in Packetbeat can lead to denial of service via specially crafted network traffic. An unauthenticated attacker who can send traffic on a network segment that Packetbeat monitors for AMQP can cause a Go runtime panic that terminates the Packetbeat process. A single crafted packet is sufficient. No AMQP authentication is necessary. While Packetbeat is not running, it does not collect network telemetry.
title: NULL Pointer Dereference in Packetbeat Leading to Denial of Service

desc: Incorrect Authorization (CWE-863) in Elasticsearch can lead to information disclosure via Accessing Functionality Not Properly Constrained by ACLs (CAPEC-1). An authenticated user whose index access is restricted by field-level security can retrieve the value of a constant_keyword field that their role excludes. Some search and query features do not apply the field-level security restriction to this field type.
title: Incorrect Authorization in Elasticsearch Leading to Information Disclosure

desc: Use of Cache Containing Sensitive Information (CWE-524) in Elasticsearch can lead to information disclosure and incorrect search results via specially crafted search requests. For some query types, Elasticsearch can share cached query results between users who have field-level security restrictions and users who do not. A user restricted by field-level security can learn which documents match a value in a field that they cannot read. A restricted user can also cause users with full access to receive incomplete search results. Disclosure is only possible when a user with full access ran the same query on the same shard recently.
title: Use of Cache Containing Sensitive Information in Elasticsearch Leading to Information Disclosure

desc: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in WPVibes AnyWhere Elementor anywhere-elementor allows Stored XSS.This issue affects AnyWhere Elementor: from n/a through 1.3.0.
title: WordPress AnyWhere Elementor plugin <= 1.3.0 - Cross Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability

desc: Use of Multiple Resources with Duplicate Identifier (CWE-694) in APM Server can lead to information disclosure via a specially crafted agent configuration request. An authenticated APM agent could receive the central agent configuration that belongs to a different service until the cached configuration expires. A service could also run with central configuration settings, such as sampling settings, that were meant for a different service.
title: Use of Multiple Resources with Duplicate Identifier in APM Server Leading to Information Disclosure

desc: Uncontrolled Recursion (CWE-674) in Elasticsearch can lead to denial of service via Serialized Data with Nested Payloads (CAPEC-230). An unauthenticated attacker with network access to the remote cluster server interface of a node can send a specially crafted request that causes the node to terminate. No credentials are required. The attacker can repeat the request against each reachable node.
title: Uncontrolled Recursion in Elasticsearch Leading to Denial of Service

desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in WPVibes AnyWhere Elementor anywhere-elementor allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects AnyWhere Elementor: from n/a through 1.3.0.
title: WordPress AnyWhere Elementor plugin <= 1.3.0 - Broken Access Control vulnerability

desc: Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in WPVibes AnyWhere Elementor anywhere-elementor allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects AnyWhere Elementor: from n/a through 1.3.0.
title: WordPress AnyWhere Elementor plugin <= 1.3.0 - Sensitive Data Exposure vulnerability

desc: An unauthenticated attacker with network access to the SonicWall GMS 9.5.2 and earlier versions may be able to read internal GMS files, potentially exposing sensitive information.

Post-authentication Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability has been identified in the End-of-Life SonicWall GMS 9.5.2 and earlier versions which in specific conditions could potentially allow an authenticated attacker to access or modify information stored in the GMS database.

Docker Sandboxes sbx cp does not safely confine host-side paths to a shared workspace. A malicious sandbox can create or replace a workspace symlink so that a later user-initiated copy reads a host file outside the workspace into the sandbox or writes sandbox-controlled data to a host path outside the workspace with the invoking user's permissions.
title: Docker Sandboxes sbx cp follows workspace symlinks outside the authorized host directory

desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in myCred myCred mycred allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects myCred: from n/a through 4.0.2.
title: WordPress myCred plugin <= 4.0.2 - Broken Access Control vulnerability

desc:
Securepoint SSL VPN Client v2 on Windows contains vulnerabilities in the handling of OpenVPN configurations and proxy settings that allow non-privileged local users to influence operations performed with NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM privileges.



Two attack vectors have been identified:

  *  

Improper authorization of configuration checksum updates: The privileged service does not properly validate the authorization of connecting clients when updating the checksum of an OpenVPN configuration. This allows a non-privileged local user to modify an OpenVPN configuration and set a valid checksum without administrator privileges. The modified configuration is subsequently processed with NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM privileges.


  *  

Argument injection via proxy settings: The client does not properly validate or sanitize proxy settings before passing them as arguments to OpenVPN. A non-privileged local user can inject additional arguments through the proxy settings, influencing the execution of OpenVPN with NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM privileges. This attack vector does not require direct communication with the privileged service or modification of the protected OpenVPN configuration.
title: Local Privilege Escalation via OpenVPN Configuration and Proxy Settings in Securepoint SSL VPN Client v2 for Windows

desc: NVIDIA Slurm contains a vulnerability where a user could deliberately alter the provided nodelist alongside the --distribution=arbitrary option to gain access to compute nodes outside of the current job allocation.
NVIDIA Slurm contains an attacker-controlled heap-based buffer overflow in the slurmstepd socket handling code.

Volmarg Personal Management System through 2.1.0 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability that allows authenticated users to upload PHP files via the /upload/send/ endpoint. Attackers can submit base64 fileContent with a .php fileName into the web root and request it to execute code as the web server user.
title: Volmarg Personal Management System through 2.1.0 Unrestricted File Upload RCE via /upload/send/

desc: NVIDIA Slurm contains a vulnerability where a user could alter the supplemental group list as part of an sbcast file transmission to write a file to a path they would not normally have access to.
NVIDIA Slurm contains an attacker-controlled heap-based buffer overflow in the slurmstepd process while the slurmstepd is running with root permissions.
NVIDIA Slurm is subject to a symlink resolution issue in the container cleanup code that could allow an attacker to remove files outside of their control on the compute node.
NVIDIA Slurm contains an attacker-controlled arbitrary-memory read in the slurmstepd socket API that could be used to ex-filtrate authentication keys.
NVIDIA Slurm contains an attacker-controlled SQL injection attack in certain SlurmDBD RPCs that can lead to arbitrary code execution.

NVIDIA Slurm contains some inconsistent authorization checks against the Operator permission level in the SlurmDBD that can be chained together in a way that would permit an Operator to make themselves an Administrator.

CTFd 3.1.0 before 3.8.7 contains an information disclosure vulnerability in the /api/v1/teams list endpoint that exposes non-public team custom field values. Unauthenticated attackers can paginate GET requests to collect hidden registration data such as emails, phone numbers, and student IDs when team mode and public visibility are enabled.
title: CTFd 3.1.0 before 3.8.7 Information Disclosure via /api/v1/teams Endpoint

desc: Incomplete Comparison with Missing Factors (CWE-1023) in merge_chats() (whatstk/utils/chat_merge.py), reached from BaseChat.merge(), in whatstk from 0.3.0 before 0.9.0 allows a party that supplies the chat exports to cause messages to be absent from the merged output with no indication that anything was removed, because the merge keeps whole the chat whose first message is oldest and appends from the other only the messages that are strictly newer than the last message of the first. Every message of the second chat that falls inside the date range already covered by the first is therefore discarded. The two chats are compared on their date ranges and not on the identity of the individual messages, so a message held by only one of the two exports is dropped whenever its date falls inside the range of the other, and both branches of _merge_two_chats() behave this way. The merged result is returned without a warning and without a count of what was removed. This results in a merged chat that omits messages the inputs contain, in a library whose documented uses include forensic review and the generation of training data.
title: Silent loss of messages when merging overlapping chat exports in whatstk

desc: Tactical RMM contains a stored XSS vulnerability caused by improperly validated input or encode output for various fields, enabling HTML/JavaScript to be stored in the tools database, which is then executed in the browsers of users when they view content containing the infected objects, leading to account takeover or code execution.
title: CVE-2026-121578

desc: AuditPilot before commit 4669c93 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in _metadata_allowed in rag/agentic_rag.py that allows authenticated users to read other projects' knowledge by supplying project_id. Attackers with read:knowledge scoped to one project can set context.project_id via GET /api/knowledge/query or POST /api/research/answer to retrieve same-tenant project knowledge chunks.
title: AuditPilot before commit 4669c93 RAG Project-Scope Authorization Bypass via project_id

desc: GLPI 10.0.0 before 10.0.28 and 11.0.0 before 11.0.10 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows authenticated users to obtain elevated profiles by cloning accounts. A user with the Technician profile can clone a Super-Admin account with a new login and password, since User::getCloneRelations() copies every Profile_User and Group_User assignment without permission checks, yielding an attacker-controlled Super-Admin account.
title: GLPI 10.0.0 before 10.0.28 and 11.0.0 before 11.0.10 Privilege Escalation via User Cloning

desc: LogChimp 0.9.0-alpha.1 before 0.9.3 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated post authors to modify any other post by supplying mismatched postId and id body parameters. Attackers can set postId to their own post and id to an enumerated victim post UUID to overwrite its title, slug, content, boardId and roadmap_id.
title: LogChimp before 0.9.3 Authorization Bypass via PATCH /api/v1/posts

desc: WPPConnect Server through 2.10.74 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to send WhatsApp messages by calling the Chatwoot webhook route without verifyToken middleware. Attackers who know or guess a connected session name can POST outgoing message bodies to send arbitrary texts or files from that account to any number.
title: WPPConnect Server through 2.10.74 Missing Authentication via /api/:session/chatwoot

desc: Label Studio before 1.23.2 (label-studio-sdk before 2.1.2) contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows authenticated users to read internal URLs through image-bearing export formats. Attackers can import tasks with data.image pointing at internal services, export as YOLO or COCO with images to read responses, and spoof Host to capture the organization owner's API token.
title: Label Studio before 1.23.2 SSRF and Token Disclosure via Image Export Downloads

desc: PostfixAdmin through 4.0.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated mailbox users to inject script by creating a TOTP exception with an unescaped description. When a global administrator views totp-exceptions.php, the script runs in the admin session and can issue authenticated admin requests using the page's CSRF token.
title: PostfixAdmin through 4.0.5 Stored XSS via TOTP Exception Description

desc: Dromara domain-admin before 1.6.79 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the POST /api/getGroupUserList handler that allows authenticated users to read other groups' members. Attackers can enumerate sequential group_id values to disclose member usernames, leader and edit-permission flags, and owner usernames of groups they do not belong to.
title: domain-admin before 1.6.79 Missing Authorization via getGroupUserList

desc: cordova-plugin-advanced-http 1.5.0 through 3.3.1 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that leaks cookies to third-party hosts because the JavaScript layer passes jar-built Cookie headers as ordinary request headers. When a request is redirected to another host via an open or attacker-influenced redirect, native iOS and Android stacks forward the Cookie header, letting attackers hijack user sessions.
title: cordova-plugin-advanced-http 1.5.0 through 3.3.1 Cookie Leak via Cross-Origin Redirects

desc: Foxel through 2.4.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read files by requesting the /api/fs/stream and /api/fs/thumb endpoints. Attackers can supply a VFS mount prefix and relative path to retrieve full file contents or thumbnails across all mounts, bypassing PathRule permission grants.
title: Foxel through 2.4.0 Unauthenticated File Read via /api/fs/stream and /api/fs/thumb

desc: FastBee through 2.1.0 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in ProductController that allows authenticated tenant users to access other tenants' products by supplying their product IDs. Attackers can enumerate sequential product IDs to read MQTT account, password, and secret values, overwrite product configuration including tenant_id, or delete products with cascading rows.
title: FastBee through 2.1.0 IDOR via /iot/product By-ID Endpoints

desc: Cotonti through 1.0.0 generates registration and email-change validation tokens with md5(microtime()), allowing attackers to bypass email-ownership verification by predicting tokens. Attackers can derive the generation time from the HTTP Date header and compute candidate tokens offline. They then submit these tokens to the users.register.php validate handler to activate accounts or confirm email addresses they do not control.
title: Cotonti through 1.0.0 Predictable Validation Tokens via md5(microtime())

desc: ruTorrent before 5.3.20 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the datadir plugin that allows authenticated users to escape the topDirectory jail because correctDirectory() does not resolve symbolic links. Attackers can submit a datadir path through a symlink under their top directory to create directories and move torrent data to locations writable by the web server or rtorrent.
title: ruTorrent before 5.3.20 Path Traversal via datadir Plugin Symlink Following

desc: Canop dysk before 3.8.2 contains a terminal escape sequence injection vulnerability that allows local users to inject control sequences by crafting mount metadata rendered unsanitized in table and CSV output. Attackers can create FUSE mounts with ESC/OSC sequences in mount-point names or fsname, causing spoofed or hidden output and window-title changes when another user runs dysk.
title: dysk before 3.8.2 Terminal Escape Sequence Injection via Mount Metadata

desc: Jarun nnn through 5.3 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in plugins/togglex that allows attackers to execute commands via crafted filenames. Attackers can place files whose names contain a double quote and shell syntax, which xargs -I splices into an sh -c script, running commands as the user invoking togglex.
title: nnn through 5.3 OS Command Injection via togglex Plugin

desc: nnn through 5.3 contains an insecure file handling vulnerability that allows local attackers to redirect writes because main() accepts an existing NNN_FIFO path without verifying it is a FIFO. Attackers can pre-create the documented predictable /tmp/nnn.fifo path as a symlink or readable regular file, causing victim-writable files to be overwritten or leaking the victim's browsed paths.
title: nnn through 5.3 Symlink-Following Write via NNN_FIFO Handling

desc: Dreeve before 5.8.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in StravaWebhookRequestHandler::handleEvent that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge Strava webhook events without signature, verify-token or owner_id checks. Attackers can send forged delete events with a known public Strava activity id to the webhook URL, causing permanent deletion of imported activities and their streams.
title: Dreeve before 5.8.0 Missing Authentication in Strava Webhook POST Handler

desc: nnn through 5.3 contains an insecure temporary file vulnerability in the pdfread and nuke plugins that allows local attackers to overwrite files by exploiting predictable paths in /tmp. Attackers can pre-create a symlink at the name-derived or PID-derived path so the victim's plugin truncates and overwrites any file the victim can write.
title: nnn through 5.3 Insecure Temporary File Symlink Overwrite via pdfread and nuke Plugins

desc: smart-sso through 2.0.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in PermissionFilter that allows any authenticated user to call admin console APIs because unlisted paths are permitted by default. Attackers can call /admin/user-role/save to assign themselves the administrator role, reset passwords, and manage users, roles, and applications across integrated systems.
title: smart-sso through 2.0.1 Incorrect Authorization in PermissionFilter Enables Admin Escalation

desc: Koodo Reader through 2.4.6 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the self-hosted HTTP server's OPDS handlers that allows authenticated attackers to read files outside the upload directory. Attackers can upload a crafted books.db with a cover value containing ../ sequences, then request /opds/cover/{key} to read files accessible to the server process.
title: Koodo Reader through 2.4.6 Path Traversal via OPDS Cover and Download Handlers

desc: bbs-go through 4.4.6 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability that allows network-positioned attackers to intercept SMTP traffic because sendEmail() sets InsecureSkipVerify to true. Attackers can present any certificate to capture SMTP PLAIN auth credentials and read or modify outgoing password-reset and verification emails.
title: bbs-go through 4.4.6 Improper TLS Certificate Validation in SMTP Email Service

desc: SQLBot through 1.10.3 contains a path traversal vulnerability in the importToDb endpoint that allows authenticated workspace administrators to read files via an unsanitized filePath parameter. Attackers can supply absolute paths or ../ sequences to import CSV or spreadsheet files, including other workspaces' uploads and server files, into queryable excel_* tables.
title: SQLBot through 1.10.3 Path Traversal via datasource importToDb Endpoint

desc: DbGate before 7.3.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows connection-restricted authenticated users to bypass LOGIN_PERMISSIONS because test() and save() never call testConnectionPermission. Attackers can submit arbitrary connection definitions to POST /connections/test to probe internal database hosts, or to /connections/save to overwrite stored connections.
title: DbGate before 7.3.3 Missing Authorization via /connections/test and /connections/save

desc: Padloc through 4.3.0 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in ScimServer._handleScimGet() that allows unauthenticated attackers to read SCIM directories by sending any non-empty bearer token. Attackers who know an organization id can query the Users and Groups SCIM endpoints to retrieve provisioned usernames, emails, names, externalIds, and group memberships.
title: Padloc through 4.3.0 Missing SCIM Token Validation via SCIM GET Requests

desc: HDF5 through 2.2.0 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability in H5L__extern_traverse() in src/H5Lexternal.c, the default traversal callback for external links. The callback locates the target file name and object path within the link’s user data using strlen() without validating the buffer against its stored size (udata_size, which was marked unused). A crafted HDF5 file containing an external link whose data is not NULL-terminated, or is too short to hold both strings, causes strlen() to read past the end of the udata heap buffer, and the derived object path pointer may also point outside the buffer. The overrun is unbounded and continues until a zero byte is found. The flaw is triggered when the malicious link is traversed, for example when opening an object through it. An attacker who can get a user or application to access a crafted file can cause a denial of service, and adjacent heap contents may be incorporated into the external file name or object path the library attempts to open.
title: Heap Buffer Over-read via Non-Terminated Link Data in H5L__extern_traverse

desc: HDF5 through 2.2.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in H5HL_unprotect() in src/H5HL.c. H5HL_protect() pins a single metadata cache entry for a local heap, either the heap prefix or the separate data block, and H5HL_unprotect() unpins it on the final unprotect. When the metadata cache destroys a corrupted local heap entry, H5HL__prfx_dest() unlinks it from the heap by setting heap->prfx or heap->dblk to NULL. A crafted HDF5 file can therefore reach H5HL_unprotect() with no cached object to unpin, and the function passes the NULL pointer to H5AC_unpin_entry(). This causes an assertion failure in debug builds and a NULL pointer dereference and crash in release builds. An attacker who can get a user or application to open and traverse a malicious file can cause a denial of service.
title: NULL Pointer Dereference in H5HL_unprotect via Corrupted File

desc: A flaw has been found in Ziroom ZHOME A0101 1.0.1.0 Build 202004151405. This issue affects the function loadstring of the file usr/lib/lua/luci/controller/api/zrUsb.lua of the component Lua Handler. This manipulation causes code injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
title: Ziroom ZHOME A0101 Lua zrUsb.lua loadstring code injection

desc: AB Download Manager before 1.11.2 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in its unauthenticated browser-integration API that allows remote attackers to write attacker-chosen files to arbitrary paths. A malicious web page can send a text/plain request to /start-headless-download with crafted folder and name values, placing payloads in startup folders for code execution on next login.
title: AB Download Manager before 1.11.2 Arbitrary File Write via /start-headless-download CSRF

desc: CFNext before 3.1.0 contains a weak cryptographic derivation vulnerability that allows subscription link holders to recover the admin password because the subscription UUID is an MD5 of the password with a fixed public salt. Attackers can brute-force the password offline without rate limiting, log into the admin panel, and read stored Trojan, Clash, Telegram and Cloudflare API secrets.
title: CFNext before 3.1.0 Admin Password Recovery via MD5-Derived Subscription UUID

desc: HDF5 through 2.2.0 contains an uninitialized memory read vulnerability in H5Z__filter_scaleoffset() in src/H5Zscaleoffset.c. The decode path validates reads against the allocated size of the chunk buffer rather than the number of bytes actually read from the file. Because H5D__chunk_lock() deliberately sizes filtered chunk buffers to the larger of the stored and unfiltered chunk sizes and fills only the stored bytes, a truncated chunk passes these bounds checks and is decompressed from the uninitialized remainder of the allocation. Unrelated heap contents are then returned to the caller as dataset data. Because the reads remain within the allocation, the issue is not detected by AddressSanitizer. An attacker who can get a user or application to read a dataset from a crafted HDF5 file can cause disclosure of process memory. This issue exists because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2026-19029.
title: Uninitialized Heap Memory Disclosure via Truncated Chunk in HDF5 Scale-Offset Filter

desc: HDF5 through 2.2.0 contains an out-of-bounds read vulnerability in H5Z__filter_szip() in src/H5Zszip.c. When decoding a szip-compressed chunk, the function subtracts the 4-byte uncompressed-length header from the chunk length without first verifying that the chunk is at least 4 bytes long. A truncated or corrupted chunk shorter than the header causes the length calculation to wrap around to a very large value, and the decompressor reads far past the end of the chunk buffer. An attacker who can get a user or application to read a dataset from a crafted HDF5 file can cause a denial of service. Only builds with szip support (libaec or the szip library) are affected.
title: Integer Underflow Leads to Out-of-Bounds Read via Truncated Chunk in HDF5 Szip Filter

desc: HDF5 through 2.2.0 contains a heap buffer over-read vulnerability in H5O__chunk_deserialize() in src/H5Ocache.c. When decoding object header messages, the declared message size is checked against the end of the chunk image before the remainder of the message header (flags, and for version 2 object headers, the optional creation index) has been decoded. Because the message body begins after these fields, a message can start up to four bytes further into the chunk than the size check accounts for. A crafted HDF5 file can declare a message size that passes the check but extends past the end of the chunk image, causing the message’s decode callback, for example H5O__mtime_new_decode() in src/H5Omtime.c, to read beyond the heap allocation. The flaw is reachable during H5Fopen() on a crafted file. An attacker who can get a user or application to open a malicious file can cause a denial of service or limited disclosure of process memory.
title: Heap Buffer Over-read via Malformed Message Size in HDF5's H5O__chunk_deserialize

desc:
Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key vulnerability in team-alembic ash_authentication allows a user with an account to install a TOTP secret they control on another user's account, and then sign in as that user or hold their second factor.

AshAuthentication.Strategy.Totp.ConfirmSetupChange verified a setup token but did not check that it was issued to the record being confirmed, so an attacker's own pending secret could be confirmed onto another user's record. The TOTP setup changes, ConfirmSetupChange, GeneratePendingSetupChange and GenerateSecretChange, also marked their changesets as AshAuthentication interactions, which the standard AshAuthenticationInteraction policy bypass lets through. A policy limiting setup and confirm_setup to the actor's own record therefore never ran when an application exposed those actions by record key, and a direct setup call on another user's record returned that user's pending secret and setup token.

This issue affects ash_authentication: from 5.0.0-rc.0 before 5.0.0-rc.16.
title: AshAuthentication TOTP setup lets a user install their own authenticator secret on another user's account

desc: rsync before 3.5.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in the delta-transfer sender's hash_search() in match.c that allows malicious receivers to trigger unbounded strong-checksum work at consecutive offsets. Unauthenticated attackers pulling from a public daemon module can supply weak checksums colliding with consecutive rolling windows plus non-matching strong checksums, exhausting sender CPU across concurrent connections.
title: rsync < 3.5.2 Denial of Service via hash_search() Checksum Collisions

desc:
Improper Restriction of Excessive Authentication Attempts vulnerability in team-alembic ash_authentication allows an unauthenticated attacker to guess passwords and one-time passwords without limit.

The password, magic link and OTP strategies enforce brute_force_strategy by adding a preparation only to the actions they generate. When the resource defines one of those actions itself, the strategy uses it as written and nothing checked that it carried the preparation, so the setting compiled and applied no limit. The generators produce exactly this: mix ash_authentication.install writes sign_in_with_password, request_password_reset_token and request_magic_link, mix ash_authentication.upgrade then adds brute_force_strategy to those strategies, and mix ash_authentication.add_strategy.otp writes its OTP actions without the preparation. Separately, with registration_enabled? true the OTP sign-in is a create action, which preparations do not run on, so brute_force_strategy {:preparation, module} never applied to it.

This issue affects ash_authentication: from 5.0.0-rc.4 before 5.0.0-rc.16.
title: AshAuthentication brute_force_strategy does not limit sign-in and request actions defined on the resource

desc:
An issue was discovered in Django 6.1 before 6.1.3, 6.0 before 6.0.10, and 5.2 before 5.2.19.
The `django.middleware.cache.UpdateCacheMiddleware` and the `django.views.decorators.cache.cache_page()` decorator generate identical cache keys for requests that omit a header listed in the response’s `Vary` header and requests that include that header with an empty value, potentially allowing remote attackers to access private data cached for another request.
Earlier, unsupported Django series (such as 5.1.x, 5.0.x, and 4.2.x) were not evaluated and may also be affected.
Django would like to thank Andrew Gonzalez for reporting this issue.
title: Potential exposure of private data via empty and missing Vary headers

desc:
An issue was discovered in Django 6.1 before 6.1.3 and 6.0 before 6.0.10.
The `django.contrib.admin.utils.display_for_field()` function did not obfuscate the password field of user models other than `AUTH_USER_MODEL`, or of an `AUTH_USER_MODEL` inheriting its password field from a concrete parent model through multi-table inheritance, which allows authenticated staff users with only the view permission on such a model to obtain full password hashes via the read-only change form.
Earlier, unsupported Django series (such as 5.1.x, 5.0.x, and 4.2.x) were not evaluated and may also be affected.
Django would like to thank Aaron chen for reporting this issue.
title: Password hash disclosure to "view only" admin users with custom user models

desc:
An issue was discovered in Django 6.1 before 6.1.3, 6.0 before 6.0.10, and 5.2 before 5.2.19.
`django.contrib.gis.gdal.SpatialReference` (and related `transform()` methods and `srs`/`srid` setters) do not restrict GDAL’s file and network access when parsing string input, which allows attackers to trigger server-side requests or local file reads via crafted spatial reference strings.
Earlier, unsupported Django series (such as 5.1.x, 5.0.x, and 4.2.x) were not evaluated and may also be affected.
Django would like to thank Adraca for reporting this issue.
title: Server-side request forgery via SpatialReference string input

desc: In Eclipse Vert.x versions [4.0.0, 4.5.35] or [5.0.0, 5.2.2], the `FrameParser` in vertx-stomp creates a `RecordParser` without setting `maxRecordSize`, so any peer that streams bytes continuously without a newline character causes the parser to accumulate data indefinitely. Both the STOMP server and the STOMP client are affected: a malicious server can exploit this against a connecting client, and a malicious client can exploit this against a server before or after authentication. Sustained byte streaming exhausts JVM heap memory, crashing the affected process and causing a complete denial of service.
title: Heap exhaustion via unbounded line accumulation in Vert.x STOMP FrameParser

desc:
An issue was discovered in Django 6.1 before 6.1.3, 6.0.4 before 6.0.10, and 5.2.13 before 5.2.19.
`django.http.multipartparser.MultiPartParser` is subject to excessive memory consumption when processing multipart file uploads with base64 `Content-Transfer-Encoding`, which could be buffered entirely in memory before being passed to upload handlers.
Earlier, unsupported Django series (such as 5.1.x, 5.0.x, and 4.2.x) were not evaluated and may also be affected.
Django would like to thank Ignacy Kujawa for reporting this issue.
title: Potential memory exhaustion in MultiPartParser via base64-encoded file upload

desc:
An issue was discovered in Django 6.1 before 6.1.3, 6.0 before 6.0.10, and 5.2 before 5.2.19.
`django.contrib.gis.forms.widgets.BaseGeometryWidget.deserialize()`, used by `django.contrib.gis.forms.GeometryField`, does not escape invalid submitted values before logging them, which allows remote attackers to inject or forge log entries via a crafted geometry value.
Earlier, unsupported Django series (such as 5.1.x, 5.0.x, and 4.2.x) were not evaluated and may also be affected.
Django would like to thank Aaron chen for reporting this issue.
title: Potential log injection via unescaped geometry form values

desc:
An issue was discovered in Django 6.1 before 6.1.3, 6.0 before 6.0.10, and 5.2 before 5.2.19.
`django.contrib.gis.gdal.OGRGeometry` does not restrict external coordinate reference system definitions in GeoJSON input, which allows remote attackers to cause server-side requests to attacker-selected destinations via crafted crs members.
Earlier, unsupported Django series (such as 5.1.x, 5.0.x, and 4.2.x) were not evaluated and may also be affected.
Django would like to thank Submersion Security Research Team for reporting this issue.
title: Server-side request forgery via crs member of GeoJSON geometries

desc: An out-of-bounds read condition in the AMD Compressonator SDK could allow an attacker with local access to supply a specially crafted Truevision Advanced Raster Graphics Adapter (TGA) file to a user or an automated pipeline, potentially resulting in disclosure of sensitive heap memory contents or denial of service.

An integer overflow condition in the AMD Compressonator SDK could allow an attacker with local access to supply a specially crafted DirectDraw Surface (DDS) file, potentially resulting in denial of service (DoS).

A heap-based out-of-bounds (OOB) read vulnerability in the AMD Compressonator SDK could allow an attacker with local access to read out-of-bounds heap memory, potentially resulting in information disclosure or application crash.

An out-of-bounds write (OOW) condition in the AMD Compressonator SDK could allow an attacker with local access to supply a specially crafted DirectDraw Surface (DDS) file to a user or an automated pipeline, potentially resulting in heap corruption or denial of service (DoS).
A NULL pointer dereference in the Linux GPU driver could potentially lead to a kernel crash and result in denial of service.
